name: HOLLYWOOD GARBAGE
description: Hollywood Garbage (also known as Junk Poker or Garbage) is a multi-phase social gambling game played with a massive deck (often 2-3 standard decks). It combines elements of Poker, Bingo, and simple card-matching. It is designed for large groups and operates through a sequence of phases that slowly deplete a shared pot of coins or chips.

content.text: Hollywood Garbage (also known as Junk Poker or Garbage) is a multi-phase social gambling game played with a massive deck (often 2-3 standard decks). It combines elements of Poker, Bingo, and simple card-matching. It is designed for large groups and operates through a sequence of phases that slowly deplete a shared pot of coins or chips.
A traditional American 'parlor' game, likely emerging in the mid-20th century as a more complex version of simple matching games for small stakes.

items.text: Four-flush in Poker: A four-flush (four cards of one suit) beats a pair but loses to two pairs in the poker phase.
Buy extra card (Poker): A player may buy an extra card for a set amount of coins and discard one card in exchange.
Five-card Put and Take: Some play with only 5 cards turned in each part of Put and Take, so maximum put or take is 5 per card rather than 10.
